name: Security Audit Runner
desc: Run lynis audit and generate a summary report
command: sudo lynis audit system --quick 2>&1 | tee /tmp/lynis-report.txt && echo 'Report saved to /tmp/lynis-report.txt'
author: RH Security

name: Docker Cleanup
desc: Remove all unused Docker containers, images, and volumes
command: docker system prune -af --volumes && docker volume prune -f
author: DevOps Team
